modern: Is my understanding sufficient for this or not? If it is sufficient, I use it for the work as an instrument given by the universal nature. But if it is not sufficient, then either I withdraw from the work and give way to someone who can do it better, unless there is some reason why I ought not to do so; or I do it as well as I can, taking to help me the man who, with the aid of my ruling principle, can do what is now fitting and useful for the general good. For whatever I can do, either by myself or with another, ought to be directed to this alone: to what is useful and well suited to society.
